name: Divine Spark (Harm)
description: Channel Divinity: point your Holy Symbol at a creature within 30 feet. It makes a Constitution saving throw, taking Necrotic or Radiant damage equal to 1d8 + your Wisdom modifier on a failure (rolling more dice at levels 7/13/18), or half as much on a success.

name: Divine Spark (Heal)
description: Channel Divinity: point your Holy Symbol at a creature within 30 feet and restore Hit Points equal to 1d8 + your Wisdom modifier (rolling more dice at levels 7/13/18).

name: Radiance of the Dawn
description: Channel Divinity: present your Holy Symbol to emit a flash of light in a 30-foot Emanation. Magical Darkness in the area is dispelled, and each creature of your choice in it makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 2d10 + your Cleric level Radiant damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.
